effect: The cloud-born stars also survive the crossing on changed paths, showing how becoming compact, widely separated stars changed the material's response to the encounter.
reaction: The contrast with the colliding gas clouds was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cloud-born stars through the crossing made the contrast between colliding gas and passing stars clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second action was predictable and the only remaining gameplay choice, though its explanation was worthwhile.

surprise.text: The old stars survived without returning to their old orbits; survival meant joining a changed system.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: each directly followed one of the two stellar populations.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see what happens next to the merged system, although this chapter offered few meaningful choices.
